answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake and earn reputation only through verified completed jobs, like a trellis that supports growth only where work is real. A new haven of fake identities cannot vote or earn until it has done costly, checkable work, and splitting stake across clones dilutes each one below the threshold. At its nadir, an attacker with limited funds holds many weak identities but no influence, because influence follows proven work and stake at risk of slashing, not headcount.
